summary: Move Part: Ordering of the Line is Incorrect in Target Line Dropdown
reported_issue: In the 'Move part to line' modal, the Target Line dropdown listed the available lines in the wrong order.
expected_after_fix: Target Line dropdown shows only the other lines (current line excluded), in correct positional order.
steps_i_followed: Logged in as admin and opened a 4-line Work Order (S9-24073) on its Lines tab.
Confirmed the line order: 1-Brake Pads, 2-Engine Oil Filter, 3-Air Filter, 4-Engine Oil Change.
Opened the context menu on a part that sits on line 2 (Engine Oil Filter) and chose Move.
Opened the Target Line dropdown in the 'Move part to line' modal and read the option order.
actual_now: The Target Line dropdown lists exactly 3 options in correct positional order: '1 - Brake Pads', '3 - Air Filter', '4 - Engine Oil Change'. The part's own line (2 - Engine Oil Filter) is correctly excluded, and the remaining lines appear in ascending position order.
notes: Used an existing 4-line WO rather than creating one named 111/222/333/444; the ordering behavior tested is identical. Dropdown excludes the source line and preserves positional order.
